items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 31
items.text: Every recovery, though it may go unnoticed, improves the world in some way.
items.attribution: “Why I Keep Coming Back,” Toledo, Ohio, May 2001, Voices of Long-Term Sobriety

items.attribution: “Décima Tradición”. NUEVA YORK, NUEVA YORK, MAYO DE 1971
